item.title: DeskFit 0.5.0 - AppUpdater Migration
item.description:
DeskFit 0.5.0 - AppUpdater Migration

🔄 Major Architecture Update: Migration from Sparkle to AppUpdater framework

  • 🔄 AppUpdater Integration - Modern GitHub Releases-based update system
  • ✨ Simplified Updates - No manual appcast.xml management needed
  • ✅ Full Apple notarization and Gatekeeper approval
  • 🚀 Universal Binary - Native support for Intel (x86_64) and Apple Silicon (arm64)
  • 💪 Enhanced stability with improved error handling
  • 🎨 Complete icon system for all macOS sizes
  • 📦 All features working on macOS 14.0+

Note: This is the final Sparkle-compatible release. Future updates will use AppUpdater's GitHub Releases API.

item.title: DeskFit 0.4.2
item.description:
DeskFit 0.4.2 - Universal Binary Support

Universal Binary: Now supports both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs with a single app!

  • ✅ Universal binary - works on both Intel (x86_64) and Apple Silicon (arm64) Macs
  • ✅ Native performance on both processor types
  • ✅ Single app bundle for all Mac users
  • ✅ Enhanced stability and performance optimizations
  • ✅ Bug fixes and improvements

Note: This universal binary is ~2x larger due to including both architectures.
